snippet:
Paid $100 for interior detailing and this was honestly a terrible experience. The job was very poorly done there’s still visible dirt, crumbs, and dust on the seats and floor. It barely looks like anything was actually detailed. What makes it worse is I even tipped $20 thinking they did a good job but I didn’t check closely before leaving that’s on me. After seeing it properlyI feel completely ripped off.

For $120 total, I expected a deep clean, not a rushed and incomplete job. Very disappointing. Definitely not worth the money. First and last time coming here.

Nothing says money wasted than paying $105 to get your vehicle cleaned and get it back unfinished. I had to go to something and couldn't wait for it to be redone. Would've been better off just paying the guy at the stop light to clean my windshield.
$59 for a wash and this is what you get? Total rip off.

Update: downgrading this to a 1 star. Came back 6 months later for the free car wash I earned in points after getting my car "detailed". Not only am I still finding white cleaning product residue from 6 months ago all over my car, now my car's body and glass are all covered in fibers that came off of the drying rags. This place is focused on speed and nothing else, your car will come out sloppily cleaned at best, and coated in cleaning products at worst.

Original review:

Did the top of the line detailing. Car returned with globs of cleaning product still on the body in places, rear windshield with hand smudges.

My car was much much cleaner than it arrived, but not very detail oriented for a car detailing shop, and at that price... Convenience factor is very high, though. No appointment necessary

It's a shame that this is one of the only interior/exterior carwashes in the city. Every single time my car is half done and I have to ask the simplest thing like wipe down the interior. Even the exterior just sits and is spotted by the time they come to wipe it down.

They adjust all the settings and seats, windows, and mirrors in the 10 seconds they have to drive the car and they don't put anything back.

I've given them a try multiple times over the last decade and it's always the same thing.

For $50 it's an absolute rip off.

This WAS a great car wash… ownership has reduced workforce and the service has diminished.  You will wait for over an hour to get the basic $40 service and the job is not well done. Today they had a 4 member crew working; way understaffed.  Keep driving down to South Van Ness and 16th, there is another car wash there.

Efficient and the people are nice and do a good job. Only group is that my mats, seats and exterior were not wiped down as good as what I'd like and there were plenty of. Wet spots. Disappointing for what I paid.

Pretty average service for the price. Left a few dirty spots both in the interior and exterior and the fragrance included into their "executive" wash was not provided. You can find better service for $55 for sure.
